title: 'India can take risks, hit hard': NSA says message to world clear after Op Sindoor
content: National Security Adviser Ajit Doval conveyed India's strong stance against adversaries.  Operation Sindoor was launched after a terror attack in Pahalgam. This action concluded an 88-hour conflict, forcing Pakistan to seek peace.

title: Watch: UP thief checks in, bathes & dances in bike showroom before the real act

The intruder then selected a premium motorcycle and rode away with accessories. Police are investigating the incident and circulating the suspect's photograph. The thief's leisurely actions were captured on extensive CCTV footage.

title: Manav Suthar: The all-weather finger spinner India needs after Ravindra Jadeja
content: Manav Suthar is a classical left-arm spinner who stands out in modern cricket for his artistry, skill, and dedication. Praised by experts like Maninder Singh, Suthar impresses with his seamless action, wrist magic, and high revolutions on the ball. His adaptability and work ethic have earned him recognition in both domestic and international cricket, marking him as replacement for Ravindra Jadeja and an all-weather finger spinner.

Police are investigating the incident and seeking cost recovery for the damaged equipment.

title: Google's former chief scientist shares tips to protect knees and ankles after injury
content: Jeff Dean shared his simple joint protection habits for intense workouts. He uses squishy running shoes and replaces them regularly for better impact reduction. Arch support inserts further help protect his knees and ankles from strain. Dean's ankles remain a concern due to past basketball injuries. His active lifestyle includes soccer, gym sessions, yoga, and running.

title: Independence Day: Best messages, quotes, wishes & images to share
content: In 2026, India will commemorate its 80th Independence Day on a Saturday, starting with a heartfelt flag hoisting ceremony led by the Prime Minister. The nation's vibrancy shines through as homes and public spaces are adorned with the tricolor, embodying the Har Ghar Tiranga campaign. This piece provides inspiring suggestions for messages, quotes, and shareable images to enhance your celebration and spread joy on social platforms.

title: BCI-NALSAR row: Who is Manan Kumar Mishra and why is he in spotlight?

Proceedings were closed after considering various representations from the public.

title: 800 kmph in 5.3 seconds: China train sets third record in six months
content: China's experimental maglev train achieved 800 kmph in just 5.3 seconds. This remarkable acceleration sets a new world record for short-distance travel. The technology is not intended for passenger transport due to extreme acceleration levels. Instead, it may find future uses in rocketry and military aircraft. Researchers are exploring its potential for industrial transport and specialized elevators.

title: Robot found 4,500-year-old sealed Great Pyramid door: Here's what happened
content: A robot has ventured into a concealed corridor within the Great Pyramid of Giza, uncovering a sealed barrier potentially dating back 4,500 years. This intriguing find reopens inquiries regarding the secrets held by this ancient structure. Employing contemporary technology, researchers were able to investigate sections previously unreachable by humans. Continued exploration may unveil significant insights into the original architecture of the pyramid.

title: From Safed Sagar to Sindoor: Renaissance of Indian Airpower
content: Operation Safed Sagar showed Indian air power's Kargil War improvisations.  Operation Sindoor in 2025 demonstrated a transformed, decisive air force.  Technological advancements and improved training fueled this significant transformation.  Joint doctrinal maturity and political resolve also played crucial roles.  Indian air power is now a strategic instrument shaping outcomes at speed.

title: Why Britain's grass is turning yellow after its driest month ever
content: After experiencing the driest July on record, England's picturesque green fields have succumbed to a fading yellow hue. This alarming trend of increasing heatwaves significantly affects lawns and public parks. While native grasses possess resilience during droughts and can deepen their roots to conserve water, extended dry periods inevitably lead them to enter a dormant state, awaiting rain.

title: US Labor official slams H-1B program, blames govt and companies, not workers
content: Inspector General Anthony D’Esposito is conducting an in-depth investigation into the H-1B visa program, highlighting its potential exploitation of American workers. He characterizes the program as a criminal enterprise. This investigation, part of a broader task force, seeks to expose various inter-state crimes. A new rule could require H-1B visa holders, upon job loss, to leave the United States immediately, erasing their previous grace period.

This figure not only highlights a considerable depletion of their fleet but also signifies a financial hit exceeding one billion dollars. The drones have been heavily deployed around the Strait of Hormuz, revealing their susceptibility.

title: 'Astronauts' land on road craters: Over 100 Jaipur residents stage unique protest

Two individuals dressed as astronauts entered water-filled potholes, simulating a lunar landscape. This unusual demonstration aimed to draw attention to neglected infrastructure and drainage issues. Residents have sought attention from local officials for several months regarding these problems. Tenders for road and drainage work have been awarded and will commence after the monsoon.

title: Jimmy Rimmer dies at 78: Football world mourns Manchester United legend
content: Former Manchester United and Aston Villa goalkeeper Jimmy Rimmer has passed away at seventy-eight. He was a European Cup winner with both clubs during his long career. Rimmer was part of Manchester United's historic 1968 European Cup-winning squad. He later became a key player for Aston Villa in their 1982 campaign. The club confirmed his death and paid tribute to the veteran goalkeeper.

title: Sauce Gardner’s $1.4 million Detroit property lawsuit takes dramatic new turn

This lawsuit arises from a botched apartment renovation project, where Gardner alleges fraud and the misuse of his identity in marketing efforts. He demands not only the refund of renovation payments but also additional compensation. This off-field conflict marks a notable chapter in Gardner’s career.

title: Colorado expands habitat protection for endangered Preble's jumping mouse
content: Colorado is taking significant steps to ensure the survival of the endangered Preble's meadow jumping mouse. Efforts focus on restoring essential streamside ecosystems and linking them to floodplains. Landowners are invited to join this initiative through voluntary conservation measures and financial support. A conservation bank was established in 2024 to facilitate these vital restoration projects, with new initiatives rolling out in 2026 to enhance habitat safeguarding.

title: Cyber fraud probe over Rs 36,000 cannot block entire bank account, says Allahabad HC
content: The Allahabad high court ruled banks should not fully block accounts during cyber fraud investigations.  Only the specific disputed amount should be frozen, allowing access to remaining funds.  The court emphasized clear communication channels for customers with blocked accounts.  This directive aims to balance investigations with legitimate financial activities of individuals.  Banks must now inform customers about grievance redressal mechanisms for frozen accounts.

title: Mitchell Starc surpasses Kapil Dev as Australia face Bangladesh nightmare

Meanwhile, Tanzid Hasan Tamim made history by scoring his first Test century in Australia. As the second day concluded, Bangladesh enjoyed a 150-run advantage, placing Australia in a tough spot to stay competitive in the series.

title: Trust paid £3,000 to save Shakespeare's birthplace from being shipped to US

A dedicated committee formed, rallying public donations and support from notable figures like Prince Albert to save the site. Their efforts culminated in the successful acquisition of the house at auction in 1847, ensuring the preservation of this cherished cultural landmark.

title: Indian-origin man rejected for H-1B 3 times finds another way to stay in US

content: the Congress questioned the Centre's approach to caste enumeration in the upcoming census . the party also alleged that political parties had not been consulted on the questionnaire . it was widely expected that the caste question would include a state-wise list .

title: Savarkar defamation case: SC quashes Lucknow Court order summoning Rahul
content: the defamation case stems from Rahul Gandhi’s remarks about VD Savarkar . the leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha had challenged td savarkar in 2022 . a bench of the high court held that the required sanction had not been obtained .

title: 'Our red line': Shehbaz Sharif threatens India with 'direct response' over Indus Water Treaty
content: shehbaz Sharif threatens a 'direct response' to new Delhi's move . he said the move came days after the Pahalgam terror attack in jammu and Kashmir . new Delhi has proved itsel to keep the IWT in abeyance following the attack .

title: Delhi HC, IGI airport, 3 govt offices get bomb threats ahead of Independence Day
content: the threats were reported to the Fire Control Room . the threatening email reportedly referred to August 15 and carried the warning, “Lal Qila ta nishana hove ga” (the Red Fort will be targeted) it also claimed that those carrying out the bombing would be dressed in khaki .

title: New York aquarium study suggests beluga whales may recognise themselves
content: four female beluga whales, three adults named Kathy, Marina and Natasha, were exposed to a large two-way plexiglass mirror and a transparent control surface . the researchers recorded and analysed their behavioural responses across 98 mirror sessions .

title: 'China stopped our army from patrolling several places in Arunachal': Rahul
content: "this is extremely alarming," Rahul Gandhi says in a post on X . he also questioned the silence of defence minister Rajnath Singh, home minister Amit Shah ji and prime minister Narendra Modi on the issue .

title: BCI action, U-turn and SC rebuke: How NALSAR protest against CJI kicked up a row
content: chief justice of india Surya Kant strongly disapproves of the bar Council of India's decision to stop enrolment of 2026 graduates . students opposed his invitation as chief guest for the university's convocation . the supreme court said students had a right to protest peacefully .

title: On cam: Eggs, muck thrown at ex-TMC MLA held in RG Kar victim's 'hurried' cremation case
content: former TMC MLA arrested in connection with alleged 'hurried cremation' of RG K ar victim . he was being escorted to a prison van to be produced before the barrackpore sub-divisional court when the crowd broke through the security cordon .

title: Where leopards lounge on trees: Inside Sri Lanka's Yala National Park
content: most people who visit national parks and wildlife sanctuaries believe they are animal lovers may not be there purely for the love of wildlife . many do not endure bumpy jeep rides under the blazing afternoon sun simply because they admire tigers or elephants . they go for two main reasons - the thrill of the chase and the desire to spot a tiger if the park has one . the moment is rarely greeted with silence and awe .
